title: agent-factory values
description: The umbrella's own keys. maku and maku-factory are free objects until their values change in rollout steps 2 to 6 (PR4).

global.description: Helm's global values, passed to every subchart.

profile.description: What the chart is for: demo (-f values-demo.yaml) or production (fails closed until rollout steps 2 to 6). Unset renders nothing.

demoValues.description: Set only by values-demo.yaml: the profile gate's proof that the demo's defaults are present.

demo.description: The two Secrets the demo needs, rendered by this chart unless an existing Secret is named.

judgeName.description: Optional: the completion judge's model on the same endpoint (the Secret's judge_model). Empty: the judge runs on name.

id.description: The App id. An integer is accepted: --set demo.githubApp.id=123 passes one.

tls.description: The broker's CA and certificate, generated by Helm.

monitoring.description: Observability (D21), every switch off: monitoring objects render only when asked. Each needs the prometheus-operator CRDs (monitoring.coreos.com/v1).

serviceMonitor.description: ServiceMonitors for the broker and the factory; PodMonitors for the run-controller, the egress proxy (mode kubernetes) and the model-gateway proxies (maku-gateway.enabled).

cilium.description: maku's networkPolicies mode cilium: the scraper, admitted on :9090 of the broker and the run-controller.

fromEndpoints.description: Cilium endpoint selectors of the scraper's pods.

prometheusRule.description: The PrometheusRule maku: the product alerts, a group per enabled component.

disabled.description: Alert names to leave out; each must name a chart alert.

kubeStateMetrics.description: Render the rules that read kube-state-metrics' kube_* series.

docsURL.description: The runbook_url base. Empty: the release's docs on GitHub.

dashboards.description: The product dashboards, one ConfigMap each, for Grafana's dashboard sidecar or a grafana-operator configMapRef.

labels.description: The sidecar's label set. Empty: grafana_dashboard: "1". Set: replaces it.

annotations.description: Added to each ConfigMap, e.g. grafana_folder.

slack.description: The Slack App (D20). Until its subchart lands (v4 step 6 PR E), enabled only adds the maku-slack alert group.

maku.description: The maku subchart (its own values). The keys below are also substituted into the PrometheusRule's PromQL, so they may not carry a double quote or a backslash.

maku-gateway.description: The model gateway subchart (charts/maku-gateway, its own strict schema).

agentgateway.description: The upstream agentgateway controller subchart, v1.6.0.
